item.title: Glen Phillips
item.description: Glen Phillips, an honorable service member, tragically passed away on February 13th, 2026. He was born in Brentwood, New York in 1960 to Dolores and Ronald Phillips. The post Glen Phillips appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: Mary Elizabeth Thompson
item.description: Mary Elizabeth (Donley) Thompson passed peacefully on November 29, 2025, at Circle of Life Hospice in Bentonville, Arkansas. She was born January 2, 1953, in Enid, Oklahoma, to Woodrow and Sally Donley. The post Mary Elizabeth Thompson appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: Rebecca Jane (Smith) Pope
item.description: Rebecca Jane (Smith) Pope was born on February 21, 1956, in Sterling, Illinois to John M. Smith and Beverly Jean (Lemmons) Smith. Rebecca passed from this life on February 14, 2026, at the age of 69, at the Willard Walker Hospice House in Fayetteville, Arkansas, after a long battle with cancer. The post Rebecca Jane (Smith) Pope appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: Donna (Swopes) Epley
item.description: Donna (Swopes) Epley, passed to the celestial life above on Sunday, February 22, 2026, at the age of 91. The post Donna (Swopes) Epley appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: Billing failures by hospital total $800K, CEO says
item.description: The Eureka Springs Hospital has been failing to collect “professional fees” for a number of months, resulting in a loss of approximately $800,000. The post Billing failures by hospital total $800K, CEO says appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: Educating residents crucial to passing tax increase, council members stress
item.description: If they want tourists to contribute in paying for improvements to city’s water and wastewater projects, local residents will need to get educated in coming months about the importance of an increase in city sales tax, according to Eureka Springs City Council members. The post Educating residents crucial to passing tax increase, council members stress appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: Lab still working to identify remains discovered near Eureka Springs
item.description: A Texas laboratory conducting specialized DNA testing on human remains discovered in rural Eureka Springs in December 2024, hasn’t yet been able to identify the individual, but might be getting closer. The post Lab still working to identify remains discovered near Eureka Springs appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: Early voting continues ahead of Tuesday election
item.description: Early voting in the March 3 preferential primary and non-partisan judicial election will continue through Monday, March 2. The post Early voting continues ahead of Tuesday election appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.

item.title: Candidate forum Thursday at Crescent
item.description: The Greater Eureka Springs Chamber of Commerce will host a Local Area Primary Candidate Forum at 6 p.m. Thursday, Feb. 26, in the Crystal Ballroom at the 1886 Crescent Hotel. The post Candidate forum Thursday at Crescent appeared first on Eureka Spring Times-Echo.
